_doc: WOI has no level select: the settings menu's LEVEL SELECT plays the menus as a recorded session did (title, options, Start: controller reads replayed at full speed) and starts the chosen stage. The stage number is the word $FFFFDA (1-5; the loader indexes its tables with it and $FFFFDC/$FFFFDE), which the game sets to 1 when a game starts ($21FF2), so two pokes: the first time it reads 1 (the title, frame ~853) it is set back to 0, the next time (the game's start) it is set to the stage. Checked: stages 1-5 load with their own pictures (6 is black, 7 crashes). The session keeps the pokes (SESSION.poke).
